newsitem.title: USA: Steel Dynamics files for sale of shares.
newsitem.headline: Steel Dynamics files for sale of shares.

text.p: Steel Dynamics Inc said Wednesday it filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission for clearance to sell 8.4 million shares.

The registration covers 1.3 million shares to be sold by the company and 7.1 million to be sold by selling shareholders, the company said. Steel Dynamics expects $31.2 million in proceeds from its portion of the sale.

Steel Dynamics said it would use the proceeds for capital expenditures, including the addition of a seventh rolling mill stand at its hot strip mill, and for general corporate purposes. Pending such use, it expects to pay down its revolving credit obligations or invest these funds in short-term securities.
